title: 08 Onething: notes
strengths: One task, one countdown, one ring: '18:24 of 25 min' in Geist 300 inside a minute-tick track, the task name as the only sentence, stop and pause as watchOS round buttons.
Three sizes, one family, pink as the only colour.
slop_signals: A pink glow (drop-shadow) under the progress arc.
Four dashes at the top left with no label: they read as a page indicator in the wrong corner rather than a session count.
'18:24' is the same timer value as the sleep piece: reused invented data.
fixes: Label the dashes ('2 of 4') or move them under the task name.

references.what: A thin ring around a single time with one button: no glow on the ring.
Tick ring with the value in the centre and two round buttons below.
A thick white ring on black with the time inside: contrast by weight, not light.
Ring timer with the remaining time and a pause pill under it.

owner.said: most of the watch screens are okay
